subject: Draft City Charter Approval
overview: The Medford City Council held a special meeting to debate and finalize amendments to the proposed city charter before voting to submit the draft to the Mayor and state legislature.

items.title: Proposed Amendment on Term Limits
items.summary: A motion to establish eight-term limits for city councilors and school committee members and to remove the word consecutive from mayoral term limits failed.

items.title: Amendments on School Committee and Charter Review Timeline
items.summary: The Council approved amendments restoring the mayor as a voting, non-chair member of the school committee and reducing the first periodic charter review timeline from ten years to five.

items.title: Resolution on Council Press Release
items.summary: The Council approved a press release summarizing the history, deliberations, and compromises of the charter review process.

items.title: Approval of the Amended Draft City Charter
items.summary: Following public comment, the Council approved the final draft city charter as amended to be sent to the Mayor for legislative submission.
